name: Ambient Occlusion via Cone Tracing
definition: Ambient occlusion is approximated using the same cones used for diffuse reflection for efficiency. Only the occlusion value α₂ is accumulated.
summary: Ambient Occlusion via Cone Tracing approximates soft shadows by reusing diffuse cone traces to accumulate visibility losses, distinguishing itself by focusing on single occlusion accumulation rather than multiple samples.
